title: Merging classes of interchangeable symbols
summary: Symbols that appear in the same frame are merged into one class; a probe returns the class representative, so a new member is placed after a single shared frame.
core_idea: Merge symbols seen in one frame into a class and answer with its representative.

state.name: corvane
state.meaning: Class map from each symbol to its representative after every merge so far.

learning.description: Nothing is trained; classes form by merging.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: A new member joins its class after one shared frame.

capabilities.prediction: Places a new symbol in its class after one shared frame.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: Class merging is used in many symbolic systems.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: Two symbols never seen together share a class.
